noSuchUser: There is no user with that name. Check the spelling.

VIEW_CHANNEL.name: View channels
VIEW_CHANNEL.description: See channels and read their messages as they arrive.

MANAGE_CHANNELS.name: Manage channels
MANAGE_CHANNELS.description: Create, rename, move and delete channels.

MANAGE_ROLES.name: Manage roles
MANAGE_ROLES.description: Create roles below their own highest one and change channel permissions.

MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS.name: Manage emoji
MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS.description: Upload, rename and delete the server's emoji.

VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.name: View audit log
VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.description: See who kicked and banned members and changed roles, channels, invites and emoji.

CREATE_INVITE.name: Create invites
CREATE_INVITE.description: Invite new members to the server.

CHANGE_NICKNAME.name: Change own nickname
CHANGE_NICKNAME.description: Set their own nickname on this server.

KICK_MEMBERS.name: Kick members
KICK_MEMBERS.description: Remove members below their role from the server.

BAN_MEMBERS.name: Ban members
BAN_MEMBERS.description: Remove members below their role with no way back.

ADD_REACTIONS.name: Add reactions
ADD_REACTIONS.description: Add new reactions. Joining a reaction already there needs no permission.

READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY.name: Read message history
READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY.description: See messages sent before they joined the channel.

SPEAK.name: Speak
SPEAK.description: Turn on the microphone in voice channels.

STREAM.name: Share screen
STREAM.description: Share a screen or a window in a voice channel.

DEAFEN_MEMBERS.name: Deafen members
DEAFEN_MEMBERS.description: Cut others' sound in voice channels.

MOVE_MEMBERS.name: Move members
MOVE_MEMBERS.description: Move others between voice channels and disconnect them.

MANAGE_GUILD.name: Manage server
MANAGE_GUILD.description: Change the name and icon, see and delete invites.

ADMINISTRATOR.name: Administrator
ADMINISTRATOR.description: Every permission and access to every channel. Dangerous: give it only to those you trust.
